name: Grosse Pointe Academy
description:
Grosse Pointe Academy
Owned by the Religious of the Sacred Heart from 1867 to 1969, this site is now an independent school. The narrow shape of the property reflects its original use as a French “ribbon farm” extending inland from Lake St. Clair. Situated at the Grosse Pointe Academy are an 1868 structure initially used as a public school for village children; the present academy building erected in 1929; and a place of worship modeled after a French convent chapel. Each of these edifices is still in use.
